clue.text: Take in a rich man as means of getting into the swim

definitions.text: means of getting into the swim

parts.note: to take in food or drink is to gulp it down
Dives is the traditional name of the rich man in the parable of Lazarus

explanation.surface: Someone takes in a wealthy man as a way of joining fashionable society.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Into the swim' looks like the social idiom, but here the swim is literal: these are dives into a pool.
explanation.definitionFit: Headfirst plunges with arms spread like a bird are a way of entering the water.

clue.text: Followers of a game
